definitions.gloss: one's own handwriting; written by one's own hand
definitions.explanation: Something written personally by hand, as opposed to being typed, printed, or written by someone else. Emphasizes authenticity and personal authorship.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自筆|じひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧です。
examples.english: This is the author's handwritten manuscript.

examples.japanese: {自筆|じひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A handwritten letter has a special warmth to it.

examples.japanese: {遺言書|ゆいごんしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自筆|じひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かなければ→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, a will must be written in one's own hand to be legally valid.

notes:
A compound of {自|じ} (self) and {筆|ひつ} (brush, writing). Used as a noun modifier: {自筆|じひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧ (handwritten letter).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自筆|じひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧ (handwritten letter)
- {自筆|じひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧ (handwritten manuscript)
- {自筆|じひつ}⟦{証書|しょうしょ}→証書：18959_shousho⟧⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧ (holographic will — a legal term)
- {自筆|じひつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write in one's own hand)
- {自筆|じひつ}⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧ (personal autograph/signature)

In legal contexts, {自筆|じひつ}⟦{証書|しょうしょ}→証書：18959_shousho⟧⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧ refers to a will written entirely by the testator's own hand, which has specific legal requirements in Japanese law.
